text:
The Opportunity

Attribute technology and services are heavily based on eBPF technology on the Attribute sensor side and extensive ETL and data processing on the Backend (based on GCP). In order to meet the increasing challenges of the growing business, we are seeking an experienced engineer who will be working closely with our product on one hand and with the Frontend team on the other, and will be responsible for development of new capabilities as well as operational aspects of services you develop.

Responsibilities

Implementing features. From proposal through spec and implementation to maintenance. You're expected to propose things you think can be an excellent addition to the products.
Reviewing code. We believe in code reviews, and you'll soon start reviewing pull requests as well.
Providing feedback. The team plans and discusses upcoming work. We provide feedback to each other, trying to find challenges and unknowns as early as possible.
Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across your workflow, exploring unfamiliar codebases, prototyping, debugging, writing tests, and documentation.
Collaborating cross-functionally. Work with product, support, and other engineers to understand where the gaps hurt, and bring your own ideas to the table rather than waiting for a spec.

Qualifications

3+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, backend engineering, or a similar field
2+ years of practical experience with Python, Spark, and PySpark
Experience building ETL processes and working with big-data technologies such as Pub/Sub
Familiarity with Terraform and CI/CD methodologies
Experience building or operating data pipelines in a SaaS production cloud environment
Versatile developer who learns new tools and technologies quickly, uses AI effectively, and applies sound engineering judgment
Strong collaborator and independent contributor with excellent communication skills
Growth-minded, pragmatic problem solver who simplifies complexity and iterates quickly from MVPs using data and feedback

Bonus Points

Experience with C/C#
Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform

A venture-backed, early-stage AI and cybersecurity tech startup engineering breakthrough platforms to detect and neutralize sophisticated synthetic media, enterprise identity fraud, and advanced Deepfakes.
Backed by a substantial multi-million-dollar Seed round from leading venture capital funds, the company develops a multi-engine detection orchestrator combining over 10 proprietary AI/ML models with advanced cryptography and digital provenance verification (C2PA standard).
Operating with an elite founding team in a high-impact, agile environment, the company offers a unique early-stage opportunity to build core technology and foundational infrastructures from scratch.
Located in the Central District directly adjacent to primary train transit, operating on a flexible hybrid model with up to two days working from home.
Role Description-
Serving as a Founding Data / ML Infrastructure Engineer, joining as the pivotal, sole owner responsible for designing, architecting, and scaling the entire company-wide data ecosystem.
Reporting directly to the CTO, building robust, scalable data ingestion and processing pipelines handling high-throughput multimodal datasets (video, audio, and high-resolution imagery).
Leading large-scale data scraping, automated harvesting, dynamic filtering, and end-to-end dataset curation across complex real-world threat vectors and detection scenarios.
Developing production-grade Python frameworks for automated model benchmarking, dataset evaluation, performance telemetry, and reporting.
Architecting enterprise-grade dataset versioning (e.g., DVC), storage optimization, cataloging, and metadata documentation to power continuous model training and validation loops.
Collaborating closely with algorithmic researchers and core software squads to feed real-time detection engines with high-fidelity, validated training and evaluation data.

Requirements-
3 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or ML Data roles – Mandatory
Deep, proven programming mastery in Python and strong hands-on experience utilizing multimedia processing libraries and tools (e.g., FFmpeg, OpenCV, Pillow, Librosa, or equivalent) – Mandatory
Extensive, proven experience in large-scale data scraping, extraction, filtering, and systematic dataset curation – Mandatory
Demonstrated track record managing structured dataset versioning, large-scale storage, and lifecycle management – Mandatory
High degree of self-direction, intellectual autonomy, and comfort navigating shifting priorities within an agile, fast-paced early-stage startup environment – Mandatory
Strong analytical mindset, proactive problem-solving abilities, and fluent professional communication in English (written and verbal) – Mandatory

text:
Junior Developer, Data & AI
Turn raw transactions into answers retailers act on, and build the AI that explains themYour code goes to production, not to a backlog. At AppCard, the data you model powers the reports retailers use to run their business. The assistant you help build answers real merchants’ questions in plain English. You’ll see your work used within weeks.
Why engineers like working here
A modern data stack, not a legacy one. You’ll work with a semantic layer, dbt-style transformations, an orchestrator, and BI tooling. These are the skills the market is hiring for.
Real AI work, not a demo. You’ll help build a natural-language analytics assistant over live business data. You’ll tune prompts, design evaluation sets, and learn why LLM systems fail and how to measure and fix that. Most juniors don’t get this exposure.
Real data at real scale. millions of shoppers / thousands retailers / terrabytes of data. Correctness matters here, and you’ll learn to find the bug hiding in the numbers.
Ownership early. In 90 days you’ll own a pipeline or model end to end, from design through monitoring.
A named mentor and a 30/60/90 plan. You won’t be left to figure it out alone.
Small team, big surface area. You’ll work next to senior engineers, and your opinion counts in design discussions.
Code review that teaches. Every change is reviewed by someone who’ll explain the “why”, and you’ll review others too.
We encourage using AI tools well. We expect you to understand what ships, and we’ll teach you how.

What you’ll build
Data models and pipelines that turn raw transactions into trustworthy metrics
Semantic-layer definitions that power dashboards and the assistant alike
Evaluation harnesses that tell us whether the AI got better or just sounded better
Embedded reports inside the merchant-facing app

You’ll fit in if you
Have a CS degree and enjoy SQL and ML
Understand the math behind ML and statistics
Write Python comfortably
Get a little obsessed when two numbers don’t match
Like explaining your reasoning in writing

Where you’ll be in 90 days: you’ve shipped a pipeline change, run your own evaluation of the assistant, and presented your findings to the team.

Advantages:
- dbt, Dagster, Airflow, Cube, Superset or Tableau, LLM APIs, an internship or serious side project, analytical databases (Vertica, BigQuery, Snowflake).

You will serve as the product’s primary DevOps owner, with end-to-end responsibility for infrastructure, Production availability, reliability, and development and deployment workflows. The role is designed to establish a scalable DevOps capability as the product and organization grow.

Own the end-to-end cloud-native infrastructure for Jeen Talk, including Development, Test, and Production environments.
Design and build scalable, secure, and reliable infrastructure for an active SaaS product.
Lead CI/CD, deployment, and release-management processes using GitHub Actions, GitOps, and Argo CD.

Hands-on experience building and maintaining cloud-native infrastructure in a public cloud environment.
Significant experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and Terraform.
Experience with CI/CD, GitHub Actions, GitOps, and Argo CD.
Experience with Prometheus and observability, monitoring, and alerting systems.

Strong scripting skills.
